about:
Central Plains Industries LLC operates a metal fabrication facility in Clark, South Dakota, about 20 miles west of Watertown. The company was founded in 2001 and has grown to occupy over 120,000 square feet of manufacturing space.

The shop provides full-service metal fabrication including laser, plasma, and band saw cutting; press brake forming, turret punching, and sheet metal rolling; CNC machining on twin-spindle, twin-turret centers with live milling and robotic part unloading; and welding ranging from manual TIG/MIG to robotic and spot welding. Finishing capabilities cover liquid painting, undercoating, and powder coating. Quality control uses a Faro Arm, laser scanner, and digital gauges for in-process and final inspection.

The company serves industrial and automotive sectors, producing custom metal parts for manufacturers requiring machining, welding, and finishing services. Its customer base includes repeat clients who emphasize on-time delivery and part quality, as reflected in testimonials from buyers on platforms such as Mfg.com.

Founded on a "German engineering" philosophy emphasizing strong, long-lasting quality, the company positions itself as a partner of choice through continuous improvement, a broad in-house process portfolio, and a commitment to meeting customer schedules.
